title: fix: Kimi K3 thinking Off still reasons on OpenCode Zen
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes Thinking **Off** still producing reasoning, and missing **Low/High** choices, for OpenCode Zen's `kimi-k3`.

Closes #168174 (misleading OpenCode Zen Kimi K3 thinking controls).

## User Impact

Kimi K3 on Zen offers **Off / Low / High / Max**; Off explicitly disables reasoning. The provider default becomes High, while explicit saved selections remain supported. Ultra remains the separate harness mode. No configuration migration is needed.

This is scoped to Zen. OpenCode Go was not changed: the available account returned an inactive-subscription response, so its contract was not inferred from Zen.

## Why This Change Was Made

The plugin advertised only Max and stripped the effort field for Off. Zen treats an omitted effort as reasoning-enabled. Its upstream public catalog also still advertises only Max, so correcting the seed alone would be undone by refresh.

The owning plugin now preserves the live-verified `none/low/high/max` contract through catalog refresh. The existing shared request policy handles Off→`none`; the redundant K3-only stream wrapper is removed. Production delta: **−2 lines** (15 added / 17 removed); tests/test support: **+153 net** (194 added / 41 removed); docs: **+8**; no core-provider special case or new setting.

## Evidence

- Eight boundary regression cases failed on baseline `0c91469b2dabc593638e7080b6674fda5f1dee3b`, then passed: offline/refreshed catalogs × four settings, each through both direct and managed completion transports.
- **84 focused tests passed**, including Zen Responses/tool-schema handling, other model profiles, and the unchanged Go plugin.
- **4 authenticated live streaming tests passed** through the registered Zen provider: Off, Low, High, Max. Each emitted the exact expected effort and answered `391`; Off emitted no thinking.
- Baseline live API comparison: omitted effort produced 32 reasoning tokens; explicit `none` produced zero. Low/High/Max were accepted. The upstream public feed still reported Max only on October 9, 2026.
- Required independent Codex autoreview: complete, scoped-clean, no actionable P0 findings.
- Patched `pnpm build`, provider changed gates, and the additional core/tooling fixture changed gates passed. A fresh, isolated dev Gateway exposed Off/Low/High/Max (plus the separate Ultra harness mode), accepted Low from the real picker, and completed a real Kimi conversation (`17 × 19 → 323`). Inspected, sanitized before/after screenshots and an after video are attached.
- Two inherited CI fixtures are repaired alongside this change: agent-config mutation tests now release their deliberately held activation barrier before awaiting the activation-aware RPC; release-wrapper tests use the canonical source loader so foreign-CWD, no-dist execution resolves workspace sources. No production behavior was changed for these fixtures. The isolated Gateway suite passed 69/69 and release-wrapper suite passed 4/4 in [Testbox run 38025237918](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38025237918), with wrapper exit 0 and lease `tbx_01m4j24t7pke1rmt6xgnb7s6j9` stopped. The source tree and both changed fixture hashes were verified before execution. (Blacksmith may mark the backing delegated job cancelled during normal lease cleanup.)

### Commands

```sh
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/opencode/index.test.ts extensions/opencode/thinking.test.ts extensions/opencode/provider-policy-api.test.ts extensions/opencode/stream.test.ts extensions/opencode-go/index.test.ts
OPENCLAW_LIVE_TEST=1 OPENCLAW_LIVE_TEST_QUIET=0 OPENCLAW_LIVE_OPENCODE_MODEL=kimi-k3 pnpm test:live extensions/opencode/opencode.live.test.ts -t 'Kimi K3 live thinking'
node scripts/check-changed.mjs
pnpm build
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/release-wrapper-scripts.test.ts
node scripts/check-changed.mjs -- src/gateway/server.config-agent-mutations.test-support.ts test/scripts/release-wrapper-scripts.test.ts
```

After validation, the patch rebased cleanly onto `fdb73933b27`; `git range-diff` confirms an identical patch at `1100bd2b110ab8708cf3eb110a06467267bf2cd9`, and `git diff --check` passed. Incorporated main changes do not alter the Zen catalog or either completion transport.

Live credentials were supplied privately; none are included in artifacts. Documentation covers Zen-specific effort behavior and the separate Ultra mode.

### Proof limitations and follow-up

A reused scratch Gateway state failed before provider dispatch with `SessionWorkStartInvalidatedError` / session-reader validation invalidation. A newly initialized state directory using the same candidate and dedicated profile passed the actual UI flow. This is a separate session-reader lifecycle follow-up, not evidence of a Kimi failure or a claimed fix here; the operator Gateway was not changed or restarted.

Historical full-main CI had unrelated dependency-inventory, macOS accessibility, and packaged update-handoff failures. Those have been investigated separately; they are not represented here as green checks. The PR's exact-head gates are authoritative for landing.
